name: Omyaru
subtitle: Omyaru Browser for iPhone and iPad
description: Omyaru Browser for iOS (AltStore Classic) — synchronized with Android Omyaru Browser releases.

apps.name: Omyaru Browser
apps.subtitle: Privacy browser and bookshelf
apps.localizedDescription: Omyaru Browser v1.0.0 for iOS — unified privacy browser and bookshelf across iOS, Android, and Windows: profiles (18 icons & custom colors), tab groups, private tabs, top/bottom address bar, Liquid Glass UI, scroll auto-hide toolbar, Page Tools (zoom 50%~200%, find in page, per-site shield exception, desktop/mobile UA), Safari-style 120fps Hero Zoom tab overview (1~10 columns, 1:1/3:4/16:9 aspect ratio, bottom-first order, duplicate after source, drag auto-scroll, undo close), hierarchical bookmarks & date-grouped history, download confirmation to Bookshelf, built-in image preloader, tracker/ad blocker, userscripts (.user.js), incremental scroll-stitch region capture, dual-mode watermark remover (offline inpainting + web auto-inject), hierarchical folder tree bookshelf (multi-column, batch move/delete, storage manager, PDF export), instant Face ID/PIN/Password app & bookshelf lock with app-switcher privacy shield, DoH encrypted DNS & WireGuard profile manager, and full Google Drive / AES-256-GCM encrypted sync (tabs, bookmarks, history, chunked bookshelf images, sync tab reset).

versions.localizedDescription: v1.0.5 (build 114): iOS 상단 고정 헤더 사이트 상태바 영역 불투명 채움 및 하단 사이트 고정 UI가 URL 필드 섬에 가리지 않도록 obscuredContentInsets/뷰포트 인셋 적용, 오른쪽→왼쪽 밀기 앞으로가기 제스처 복구(우측 빠른 스크롤바 히트영역 정밀화), Omyaru 내장 WireGuard VPN 직접 연결·해제 엔진(AltStore 무료 서명 호환) 및 .conf 파일 공유·실시간 트래픽/IP 검사 지원.
